transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… eating has been getting out of control. Like, once I start, it feels like I’m not really there anymore, and even if I’m telling myself to stop, I just keep going until I can’t take it.
Do you usually do anything to try to get rid of the food after one of these episodes?

Yeah… I mean, usually I’ll go somewhere no one’s around, like a dorm bathroom or sometimes a quiet floor in the library, and make myself throw up. I just get scared it’s all… sitting there and turning into weight.
How often do these episodes of eating out of control happen?
Several times a week… for most of the semester. I don’t think there’s really been a week in the last few months where it didn’t happen.
Do you exercise to try to burn off calories after one of these episodes?
I don’t really know… I mean, I move around sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I have, like, a specific thing I do after.
Do you ever exercise specifically to try to burn off calories or control your weight?
I don’t think so… not in a planned way. I might walk around or feel like I should move, but I don’t really have, like, a workout I do for that.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yeah… I am. I try not to think about it, but if I see myself in a window or something and my stomach or face looks bigger, especially compared to other guys, it just… it feels really bad. Like I don’t want people looking at me.
Do you feel like you're afraid of losing control when you're eating normally, not just during these episodes?

Yeah… I think so. Even when it’s supposed to be normal, I get scared that if I start eating I won’t be able to stop. It’s like I kind of… go away, and something else takes over, and I’m telling myself to stop but I keep going.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past few months?
I’m not really sure. I don’t weigh myself that consistently, so… I can’t say if it’s been significant.
Do you think your weight or body shape is different from how others see it?

Yeah… probably. Like, I can be having an okay day, and then I’ll see my reflection in a dorm window or something and suddenly my stomach or my face looks… bigger than everyone else’s. Then it just feels like I failed at everything, and I don’t want anyone to look at me.
Have you ever had episodes where you felt like you were eating out of control without then trying to get rid of the food or burn it off?
Yeah… I mean, the out-of-control part is kind of why I came in. Once I start, it feels like I’m not really there anymore, and I keep telling myself to stop but I just… don’t, until I can’t stand it.
Do you ever exercise more than you feel is normal to try to control your weight?
I don’t really know. I mean… I exercise sometimes, but I’m not sure what counts as “more than normal.”
Do you feel like you exercise more than what's considered typical to try to control your weight?
I’m not sure. I mean… I do think about it with my weight, but I don’t know if what I do is more than typical. I guess I don’t really have a good comparison.
Have you ever used laxatives or diuretics to try to get rid of calories?

Not laxatives or diuretics, no. It’s more… after I eat like that, I usually end up making myself throw up. Like in the dorm bathroom, or somewhere quiet, because I’m scared it’s just going to turn into weight.
How often do you make yourself throw up after one of these episodes of eating out of control?
Um… it’s been several times a week, I guess. Most of this semester. I don’t think there’s really been a week in the last few months where it just stopped.
Does making yourself throw up happen every time you have one of these episodes of eating out of control?

Most times, yeah. Not literally every single time, but… usually after I eat like that I end up finding a bathroom, like in the dorm or some quiet place, and making myself throw up because I’m scared it’s just going to turn into weight.
Does making yourself throw up always happen immediately after one of these episodes of eating out of control?

Not always immediately, I guess. Usually pretty soon after, though… I’ll end up going to the dorm bathroom, or sometimes a quiet floor in the library, and make myself throw up because I can’t stop thinking the food is just… turning into weight.
Does making yourself throw up happen after every single episode of eating out of control?
Not every single one, no. But… usually, after I eat like that, I end up in a bathroom somewhere and make myself throw up. I get really scared it’s just… sitting there turning into weight.
Does making yourself throw up happen after almost every episode of eating out of control?

Yeah… almost every time. After I eat like that, I usually end up finding a bathroom, like in the dorm or somewhere quiet in the library, and make myself throw up. I just get scared it’s all sitting there turning into weight.
Does making yourself throw up happen after almost every episode of eating out of control, or is it less frequent than that?

Almost every time… yeah. I mean, after I eat like that I usually end up finding a bathroom—like in the dorm, or somewhere quiet—and make myself throw up. I just get really scared it’s going to turn into weight.
Does making yourself throw up happen after every episode of eating out of control?
Yeah… pretty much. After I eat like that, I usually end up in the dorm bathroom or somewhere quiet, like the library, and make myself throw up. I just get scared it’s going to turn into weight.
